snippet.title: Roomba Roulette: Halloween Edition 🎈🎃
snippet.description:
Roomba Roulette: Halloween Edition 🎈🎃
We are bringing an interactive lesson in robotics, random path motion, and spatial probability to the living room with this Spooky Season DIY family game! This budget-friendly STEM activity explores autonomous navigation and collision mechanics through active family play. It is a fantastic way to keep kids screen-free, active, and curious about engineering and physics principles. Save this video to your library for your next family game night!
Ingredients and Setup:
- 1 Octagon-shaped pet barrier cage
- 1 Robotic vacuum (Roomba)
- 1 Safely-mounted popping pin
- 1 Mystery Prize box (placed safely atop the Roomba)
- 16 Halloween-themed balloons (4 per player for 4 players)
Rules of the Game:
1. Set up the octagon pet cage and securely tape it down on a level table or countertop and place 16 color-coded balloons inside the arena.
2. Place on the robotic vacuum the mystery Gold Prize box in a Trick or Treat bucket full of candy. Place the Roomba inside the cage and activate its clean cycle.
3. As the vacuum navigates the enclosed arena using randomized pathing, players watch as it contacts and pops balloons with its pin.
4. The player who has the last remaining unpopped balloon in their color wins the challenge and claims the mystery Gold Prize!
Note: Make sure children are supervised while playing this kind of challenge
Tell us in the comments: Whose balloon did you think would survive until the end?
#STEMchallenge #DIYgame #RoboticsForKids #HalloweenGames #SpookySeason

snippet.title: Spooky Spider vs. Bat Dice Challenge 🎃
snippet.description:
Spooky Spider vs. Bat Dice Challenge 🎃
Test your probability skills with this fun DIY Halloween STEM challenge! Join Getti and Mike as they roll the custom cube to navigate spider and bat game pieces across the grid. Save this video for your next screen-free Spooky Season family game night!
Ingredients and Setup:
- 1 custom dice cube (2 orange, 2 white, 2 X sides)
- 1 Halloween tabletop grid
- 1 white spider balloon & 1 orange bat balloon game piece
Rules of the Game:
1. Roll the cube on your turn.
2. Roll your color to move 1 square forward.
3. Roll the opposite color, hold your position.
4. Roll an X to move 1 square backward.
5. First player to reach past the finish line wins!
#FamilyGameNight #STEMActivities #DIYGames #HalloweenGames #SpookySeaso

snippet.description:
Speed Cup Dash: Fast-Paced DIY Challenge
Zander and Getti go head-to-head in a fast-paced relay! They race back and forth down two rows to collect party cups into a bin, one cup at a time. It is an easy DIY agility and focus game for family fun.
#familygames #challenges #funtimes #games #shortsvideo  
Ingredients:
Party cups, a plastic bin, open floor space.
Rules:
1. Players start at their row of cups.
2. Pick up only one cup at a time and place it in the bin.

snippet.title: Tic Tac Toe Takes Over the Living Room
snippet.description:
Tic Tac Toe Takes Over the Living Room 
We turned a classic game into a life-size family challenge, and the girls went head-to-head with the boys. A little tape made the tic-tac-toe grid, party cups held our X’s and O’s, and a few Pop Darts made every turn a test of aim. It’s a simple DIY game you can set up at home with things you may already have around the house.
This is one of those indoor activities that kids, parents, and grandparents can all play together. You don’t have to be great at throwing, either. Part of the fun is watching where each dart lands and deciding which square to go for next!
There’s even a little science and physics in every toss, from the angle of the throw to where the dart sticks. It made for a fun, hands-on STEM moment in the middle of family game night. #OriginalGames #lasvegas #getti #TusHouse

snippet.title: Mystery Box WINNER! Match Maker Challenge Prize!
snippet.description:
Mystery Box WINNER! Match Maker Challenge Prize! 
#familygames #challenges #funtimes #games #shortsvideo  

Ingredients and Setup:
- 1 Vertical display box (open in the front, shielded from players)
- 1 Hidden stack of 12 color-coded duct tape rolls
- 1 Matching set of 12 color-coded duct tape rolls for active play
- 1 Mystery Gold Prize box

We are bringing a fun lesson in pattern recognition, memory retention, and spatial ordering to the living room with this original DIY family game challenge! This budget-friendly STEM activity tests focus and visual recall through active family play. It is a fantastic way to keep kids screen-free, active, and learning together at home. Save this video to your library for your next family game night!

Rules of the Game:
1. Stack 12 colored tape rolls vertically inside the display box so only the host and audience can see the order.
2. Players take turns selecting a colored tape roll from their matching set to build a second stack next to the hidden display.
3. If a player places a matching color in the correct order, their turn continues and they place another roll.
4. If a player places an incorrect color, their turn immediately ends and play passes to the next player.
5. The first player to complete the full 12-roll stack to match the hidden sequence wins the Mystery Gold Prize box!
#STEM #FamilyGameNight #DIYChallenges #BrainTeasers #MemoryGame
